forward_blind_test.claim: For any FUTURE 3-body standard-letter row added to CR119 that satisfies all three filters (q_abs = 0, all-distinct slots, promoted), the row's S_debit follows S = (17/16) * M_native / R^3 with positive sign (per CR129b lock), and the row qualifies as an IDEAL Paul Revere qubit candidate.
forward_blind_test.falsifier: (a) A row satisfying all three filters but whose S_debit deviates from the (17/16) form falsifies the slot decomposition.  (b) Discovery of a non-ladder (a, b, c) triple all-distinct at q = 0 with promoted status would EXTEND the candidate set without falsifying v1.0; it just shows the alpha_H-ladder structure is not the only path to ideality.
forward_blind_test.non_falsifying: Additions to the q >= 1 or repeated-slot subset of 3body_standard.  Hardware demonstrations on either candidate (whether positive or negative results) at this stage of the program.

immutability: Selection criteria, slot role map, and the two locked ideal candidates are frozen at CR061a seal time.  Future falsification or extension must be in an appeal CR within 12a.

lock_definition.alpha_H_ladder_observation: Both ideal candidates are pure alpha_H ladders: (alpha_H^k, alpha_H^(k+1), alpha_H^(k+2)) for k in {0, 1}.  The carrier/envelope/sensor slots are successive powers of alpha_H = 2.  This is the cleanest possible partition-algebra structure for a 3-body qubit, and the two candidates form a two-generation hierarchy within the q = 0 family.
lock_definition.filter_1_q0_rationale: Only at q_abs = 0 does the S_debit / M ratio = (17/16) * (1/R^3) decompose exactly as (1/4 + 9/16 + 1/4) -- the carrier/envelope/sensor weight pattern.  For q >= 1, the ratio = (4q + D)/(4R^4) does not admit this slot decomposition, so the architectural cleanliness of the Paul Revere letter is q = 0 specific.
lock_definition.filter_2_distinct_rationale: The carrier (slot a), envelope (slot b), and sensor (slot c) must carry distinguishable identities for the architecture separation in CR051 / CR054 to hold.  Rows with a repeated slot collapse two architectural roles into the same identity.
lock_definition.filter_3_promoted_rationale: Per CR060a, the alphabet is the promoted subset of CR119.  Rejected rows are wrong-controls for the boundary sensor, not qubit candidates.

ideal_candidates.role: extended generation ideal qubit (next alpha_H ladder)

lock_definition.name: PAUL_REVERE_IDEAL_QUBIT_SELECTION_3BODY_OCTET
out_of_scope: Mass-to-frequency calibration for actual qubit splittings.
Encoding / error-correction schemes over the alphabet.
Qubit candidates outside the structural-ideality filters (q >= 1 or repeated slots) -- these may still function as qubits with degraded architectural cleanliness.
lock_definition.selection_rule: An IDEAL Paul Revere qubit row is a CR119 3-body standard-letter row that satisfies ALL THREE filters: (F1) q_abs = 0, (F2) all three partition slots are distinct (a < b < c, no repeats), (F3) promoted in CR060a alphabet (stability != REJECTED_FAKE_CLOSURE).
